entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: A human rogue of the Atiin, the best sharpshooter on Thunder Junction, who joined Oko's gang to rob Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Fortune
entities.description: A horned, intelligent red steed with a poor sense of direction, Annie's special companion.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Leader of the gang that plans the heist of Maag Taranau, and father of Kellan.

entities.name: Tommy
entities.description: Annie's nephew, badly hurt by Akul's venom, who later returned to the Atiin homeland.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: A scorpion dragon who leads the Hellspurs and nearly controls Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: Akul's gang, based in Tarnation.

entities.name: Freestriders
entities.description: The criminal gang on Thunder Junction that Annie once belonged to.

entities.name: Stella Lee
entities.description: A fellow Atiin and friend of Annie.

entities.name: Atiin
entities.description: The nomadic people to which Annie belongs.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker disguised as Ashiok, the mastermind of the break-in, who incapacitates Kellan, Annie and Ral at the vault.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and member of Oko's gang.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Oko's son and a new gang member whose innate powers help against Akul.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: An ancient warlock freed from Sterling Company custody who deactivates the vault's ward.

entities.name: Satoru Umezawa
entities.description: A ninja freed in the jailbreak who helps in the vault.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A gang member who helps Annie with the jailbreak.

entities.name: Bertram Graywater
entities.description: Head of the Sterling Company, holder of the vault key.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: A powerful company with mercenaries that holds the key and whose guards the gang fights.

entities.name: Nolan
entities.description: A scholar of ancient artifacts kidnapped from a train so the gang can learn the vault's location.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrives with Sterling mercenaries and strikes Akul with thunder.

entities.name: Tinybones
entities.description: A skeleton who hides in Oko's armor, unlocks captives' chains and deactivates the security grid.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: The ancient vault at the center of Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: The Hellspurs' home base, built around Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Saddlebrush
entities.description: The remote town where Annie ranches.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The Wild West plane where Annie lives.

events.summary: After the Freestriders rob Akul and the Hellspurs, Akul hunts them and nearly kills Annie's nephew Tommy with his venom.
events.quote: Akul attacked them regardless, almost killing Annie's nephew Tommy with his venom

events.summary: Feeling responsible, Annie takes Tommy into her care and quits the gang.
events.quote: she took Tommy into her care and quit the gang

events.summary: Oko waits on Annie's porch to recruit her for a heist against Akul; she refuses at first.
events.quote: she found that Oko was waiting for her on her front porch

events.summary: Annie accepts Oko's offer and learns the heist is aimed at Maag Taranau.
events.quote: Eventually, she decided to accede to Oko's request

events.summary: Annie and Eriette break Kaervek and Satoru Umezawa out of the Sterling Company's cells.
events.quote: As they broke the ancient warlock and the ninja free from their cells

events.summary: Oko kidnaps the scholar Nolan from a guarded train while Annie and Kellan save civilians before it crashes.
events.quote: Oko decided to kidnap him from the train he was riding into town on

events.summary: Ashiok extracts knowledge of the vault and keys from Nolan's brain.
events.quote: Ashiok extracted knowledge of the vault and the keys from Nolan

events.summary: Annie, Oko, Kellan and Vraska are captured in Tarnation and Akul takes the final piece of the key; Kellan challenges Akul to a duel.
events.quote: the four were captured and brought before Akul, who took the final piece of the vault's key

events.summary: Ral Zarek arrives with Sterling mercenaries and strikes Akul; Tinybones frees the captives and Vraska petrifies their captors.
events.quote: he was struck by thunder as Ral Zarek arrived with Sterling mercenaries

events.summary: Oko reveals he had secretly told Bertram Graywater where Tarnation was, expecting the Sterling Company to arrive.
events.quote: secretly shared the location of Tarnation with Bertram Graywater

events.summary: The crew enters the vault; Annie finds the security grid and Akul and the Hellspurs arrive.
events.quote: Annie used her enhanced eyesight to search for traps

events.summary: Ashiok, revealed as Jace Beleren in disguise, incapacitates Kellan, Annie and Ral Zarek.
events.quote: arrived and incapacitated Kellan, Annie, and Ral

events.summary: As the vault collapses, Kellan controls Akul's mind, sending him into the vault so he and Annie escape.
events.quote: Kellan used his magic to control Akul's mind, sending the dragon into the collapsing vault

relations.quote: She is a friend of fellow Atiin

relations.note: Annie rides Fortune and has a special bond with him.
relations.quote: has a special connection to the horned creature Fortune

relations.note: Annie holds a grudge against the dragon.
relations.quote: she held a grudge against the dragon
Kellan tossed the key to his father
to avoid losing face in front of his gang

relations.note: He is head of the company.
